evals.prompt: Our top Meta ad has been running for 3 weeks and CTR just started dropping. What should we do?
evals.expected_output: Should diagnose this as likely ad fatigue (rising frequency, declining CTR on a previously strong ad). Should recommend refreshing creative rather than just adjusting budget, and suggest varying hook/angle first since those are highest leverage. Should recommend a steady pipeline of new concepts rather than one large reshoot.
assertions: Recommends creative refresh, not just budget/bid changes
Prioritizes hook/angle as first levers to change
Recommends ongoing creative pipeline over one-off refresh

evals.prompt: We can only produce 2 new ad concepts this week. What should differ between them to make the test useful?
evals.expected_output: Should recommend making the two concepts structurally different (different angle or format), not just cosmetic variations, so the test produces a real learning. Should suggest picking angles from the angle bank / format table rather than two versions of the same idea.
assertions: Recommends structurally different concepts, not cosmetic variants
Explains why two similar videos wouldn't produce a useful test
